main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 5-bar drift-adjusted forward return on mom28 forecast, trending grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: book mean daily return minus market-rise gain, before costs

decided_by: Only 153 grid cases on trending bars across all coins, fewer than the plan's minimum of 200.
reading: Before costs, the book's daily return is the position held after the previous bar times the coin's close-to-close return, averaged over coins per day; the drift is the mean of each coin's non-overlapping 5-bar grid returns over all its windows; the fewer-than-200-cases rule is applied as a minimum count (not observable).
